The storytelling and world-building is amazing, graphics are beautiful, and its really fun to play with friends
10/10 game imo, and I can't wait for its further updates and content
>>>>>> The worst BG series for buggy and tedious, boring plot
Boring, poorly optimised and insufferable characters
Very fun game, tactical planning adds to the complexity. Limitless potential, like an ARPG Skyrim
Exceptional game, the pinnacle of RPGs. If you're a fan of Divinity or of Faerun then you'll love this game.
Incredible game. Highly recommend to anyone that enjoys engaging with a narrative and connecting with its characters. do NOT spoil any part of the story for yourself or others!!!
Have I finished the game, no. Am I gonna start another playthrough or 5, absolutely

The content and art are amazing.
I really liked discovering the little secrets and details across the world. The amount of content is good and I look forward for the other acts.

Don't understand the appeal yeah I got "bad taste" in games so what?
I genuinely just cannot like this game it's overrated af

One of the best games I've ever played. It's literally DnD except they made a risky choice and removed the part where you have to cancel your weekly session because that one guy had something going on and can't make it. Turned out to be a great decision.
Every time I restart a new campaign I come to discover new things to do. Such an awesome alive world. Highly recommend.
the game it self is pretty good but there is still a lot of bugs in this stage of the game :)

This game is a once in a life time game 10/10. Great for solo, perfect with friends. It has something for everyone that loves to play games great story with many options and paths to follow. I will play this game for many years to come.
The same amazing quality of the Divinity series now with DnD 5e rules. Awesome implementation of the rules into a video game. I've made so many characters. I cannot wait for the final product.
Dnd oynayacak arkadasiniz yok mu? Yapayalniz bir zavalli misiniz? O zaman Baldur's Gate 3 tam size gore.

I never played PC games in this genre, or similar, before, but this is actually very fun, especially coop with friends. You really feel the Dungeons&Dragons and sometimes some Magic the Gathering influence.
The graphics are very good and gameplay is smooth, we found no mentionable bugs, but the game is quite tough on your cpu. PC was cooking. In any case, recommended if you have the time and patience ;)

I have the most amazing bf ever who build a whole a** pc for me so I can finally play BG3 with him... The game is amazing with something waiting to be discovered on every corner (The aforementioned review was definitely not written by my most outstanding boyfriend)

In Short: Amazing game, way worth the prize. I love RPGs but im not a big fan of round-based fighting. So this comes a little bit uncomfortable for me. But im getting used to it. Game is super deep and very very often replayable.
Because of the d&d-style its not one of my favorite games but its still amazing and i can absolutely recommend it for many many many semi-relaxing gaming-hours. :-)

Larian are making something really special here.
Can't wait for the full release.

Now after playing patch 8, this is truly shaping up to be a GOAT.

One of my favorite games of all time. Larian has done a fantastic job fusing their staple CRPG style with cinematic storytelling. Fantastic story and characters with a true dedication and passion visible throughout. The amount of choice you are given in this game is downright astonishing. Several years after release, I'm still stumbling across content that is new to me. There is plenty of good content to sink your teeth into in this one and the modding possibilities are sure to keep this game fresh for many playthroughs to come.

Phenomenal game (so far). Compelling characters, well-written story and a wonderful tribute to the classic D&D experience. As a newbie to the Baldur's Gate franchise, I came in with a zeal for forgotten realms exploration and I'm very impressed. I'm looking forward to being able to play the whole game and hope it's not too much longer!
just play it. its a game for everyone, i love exploring every inch of the map.

Devs are taking a while to put out the full title, but game is great so far. The story is very compelling and the world you interact with feels very alive. Sticks very true to DnD 5e rules.
Larian hit a homerun with DOS2 and they're doing it again with BG3, kudos to them for making another great game.

I have a lot of trust in this game being an excellent title on release, I already really like the mechanics. The only downsides for now have been the bugs and the lack of content, nothing unexpected for an early access.
It's one of the best games I've ever played. There is so many ways to play it and so much stuff to discover.

One of the best games I've ever played, if not the best.

Great gameplay, amazing story, amazing characters, amazing soundtrack, everything comes together to form a wonderful experience that I feel is one of the best of the year, if not one of the best of recent years.
Just finished this game, and I realized that a single playthrough isn't enough for me lol, I'll definitely be doing more playthroughs in the future, 9.8/10 👍

I'm a longtime DM and a fan of the old BG games. This game - particularly when played co-op - is super faithful to the spirit of what you get at the tabletop. It's an absolute blast. I think the move from real time with pause to turn-based is an improvement for the series and I'm really excited to see where they can take this engine. My hope is that, once the underlying technology is fine tuned, they will be able to put out more story content in the form of DLC's at a much faster pace.

Top 3 game OAT, genuinely some of the best time I've ever had play a video game. It's worth the money. If you've ever even CONSIDERED playing this game, go for it, you genuinely won't regret it.

Also Karlach is the GOAT, anything else is heresy.
It's an early access game, so it's got it's share of bugs and issues, but for the most part it's an amazing experience that definitely scratches the D&D itch.

You can beat this game a few times and still have plenty other and new intresting things to do, trust me it's worth all that money
Open world with beautiful graphics, deep characters development and romances, enormous lore with many different decision options that lead to heart taking endings
Pure work of art <33
best game if you wanted to play dnd at home. Highly recommend to everyone. nothing beats blowing the main boss sky high with runepowder barrels

Simply the finest game I have played in 20 years, and in my top 3 games of all time. For a long time I wondered whether I had outgrown computer games. I've found them increasingly boring, repetitive, boilerplate, lacking creativity, buggy, and rushed to market not to satisfy gamers, but "to maximize shareholder value" for large publishers. This trend has resulted in a steady decline in the quality of computer games since the mid-2000s IMO.

BG3 is something different. The type of quality game, designed for gamers that we USED to get. This is a superb game that definitely stands above anything that has come out in recent years, IMO.

A must play and Larian Studios is worthy of your support ... we should show game devs this is the type of game we expect again.

Returned the game after three hours. Freedom of action is not real and the NPCs are incredibly annoying caricatures of real characters. I've been playing RPGs since 1996 and have played from Dragonquest and Lufia/Estpolis to Disgea and Daggerfall, Oblivion, Skyrim etc. dozens of RPGs. I don't mind the diversity of the characters or the combat system. But the story is embarrassing. Everyone is perversely addicted to “romantic” adventures and it's rubbed in the player's face. I really wish it had been a classic heroic epic like Zelda or Ys. In my D&D sessions, we would be ashamed to play so much prurient content. I'd rather play Wizardry or Bards Tale, those are proper roleplaying games based on the classic D&D idea of adventure.

Im a different cat, but a lot of times it's the simple things. It can be graphics, sounds, just particular things or what not, that just turn me off? Well, Larian has hit it. Im giddy with excitement to see what my roll is, to see my vision of my character and play him or her. Trying Coop soon! Yes, it can be frustrating with somce bugs and such but as a friend has told me, its clay, its not cement. Keep Molding the clay guys, Im loving what you have done and thank you!

This game is filled with tons of hidden interactions, secret bonuses, and an incredible story. I highly recommend everyone play this game at least once - but you'll probably end up playing it more than once because of how different each play through will be.
A cracking meld of the RPG and tabletop genres. Excellent world, story, mechanics and graphics. Once this is fully released it'll be a masterpiece.

It's been out for two years now. They have been in a developmental cycle for awhile that have included a responsive team and massive overhauls... but that doesn't bode well for the game as a whole. They had us preorder and buy a game that was basically still in alpha testing, then had us sit around for 2 years replaying the same exact Act 1 over and over. It was a way for them to avoid paying game testers, instead they made us pay them to be their game testers for them. It has reeked of shady game development teams, but at least the gameplay has been good, so there's that. Wait until it comes out, if it ever comes out. Don't be stupid like us guinea pigs.

Best early access game I have ever played.
If you enjoyed games like Dragon Age: Origins, this is the best game in the same vein!

Baldur’s Gate 3 is one of the most impressive RPGs I’ve ever played. The amount of choice it gives you in dialogue, combat, and story feels massive. Every decision seems to matter, and the game reacts in ways that surprise me constantly. I like how the characters are written, with strong personalities and storylines that feel meaningful. The turnbased combat is well designed and tactical without being slow or boring. Even small encounters can be approached in many different ways, which keeps the game fresh. The world feels alive, with so much detail in the environments and interactions.I sadly never continued because ive got overwhelmed of the game and it was a total new type of Gaming experience for me, still i recommend it.

------- EARLY ACCESS REVIEW -------

Bladur's gate 3 is without question one of the best RPG's I've ever had the pleasure of playing and this is while its still in Early Access.
The developers continue to raise the bar of quality with every single patch with an absurd amount of changes that are either subtle and helps narrow down thematics, bugs, balance or absolute grand changes to graphics, UI, on top of releasing new items, classes, voice acting etc.

The determination the team has to flesh out and truly expand upon the game shines through and its clear that they want this game to really be as amazing as it can be.
As of Patch 6, if you're interested in seeing the game evolving, I'd recommend buying it in a heartbeat.

DnD but more entertaining for those who cant use their imagination like myself. Everything matters yet you can still do anything. Wanna have a three-way with two romances? Sure.
Wanna commit geocide and be evil the whole game? Sure.
Wanna be a pacifist and kiss everyones ass or be neutral good? Sure.
Wanna do every single region quest before moving to the next? Sure.
Wanna join your friends playthrough? Sure, it'll be totally different than yours which means new experience.

As of writing this im at the final boss and im scared to finish cause i know ill miss it.

Never played DnD or anything similar to this before. This game is a masterpiece.

All I can say is play it. You will not regret that decision (unless you don't like it then fair enough, you gave it a go).

It is expensive though, especially not going lower than 50euro, probably won't go lower for a while. But if you enjoy it, the money is worth it, with the re play ability, achievement hunting, single or multi player, coming back to it after a while etc.

After finally getting the full release this game is 100% worth it. Its beautiful to look at, the decisions matter, and you have more freedom than I think I've ever seen in an RPG. It truly does feel like a DnD session and playing with friends is a blast. Way better than anything I've played in a long time. I highly recommend this game whether you're new to DnD or a long time fan.

The best game i have ever played to date, not much for replaying games but i will be replaying this maybe a few times. game dives you into a world where every choice affects the future. 10/10. not one thing in the game i thought needed work

Amazing game the first playthrough! And the second! And the third. Still pretty good on the fourth.

And the fifth..

absolute bliss
this game has a good "dragon age origins" vibe when it comes to companions and some companion related mechanics, but it has much more to offer even in the early access.
companions feel like real actual individuals, hard to understand, annoying, rude and difficult to approach.
it looks gorgeous, it sounds gorgeous
sending enemies flying from a cliff is gorgeous
npc react differently to your origin (being a terrifying drow is fun!)
and the Underdark is just my favorite place

waiting for the full release with extreme patience
just make it good!

Absolutely love it! Big fan of the original Buldar's gates and this does not disappoint! Early Access limitations and bugs aside this is absolutely worth the scratch, can see myself playing this for a very long time to come.

This Game is amazing! I hope the players that like this style of gameplay try the game, me and my friend play it for hours and hours...after 3 years!!! we have finished the honour mode together. It is very fun indeed, so many choices, the story is rich, the characters are well built and the most fun part is the builds we can create to test in combat ! I discovered the world of Dnd through baldurs gate 3, it is truly a magical imaginative and fantastic challenge.

The main thing I can say about this game is that it already earned a spot next to the best games in Gamehalla.

I can't remember the last time I wanted to see what's next in a story... and there is so much good story everywhere. The lootwhore in me is happy, the combat is fun and very creative. I don't feel like I have to use the same abilities all the time, most fights I've done have been different than the previous one.

In case you don't like your build, change it and try another in the same run. No need to restart 1000 times, be a Paladin or a Warlock in the same run, or both!

The only complaint I have is that I wish this game would have more content, not because I finished it already but because I want to keep going forever.

Signed by
A very happy and sleep-deprived gamer.

I'm investing 1400$ into a better gaming setup just so I can romance the twink vampire in 4kHD. This game is what happens when you pay your voice actors properly, and coincidentally one of them is actually Neil Newbon.

This is a great game! I would play more but I saw that early access saves will be wiped upon the full release of the game. Whoever did the writing for this game deserves a raise! I immediately fell in love with the world and its characters! The music is great, the combat is great and the world made me want to explore every nook and cranny there was. I can't believe the sheer amount of content that is here for players especially considering this is only 1/3 of the game! I could have easily put 40+ hours into this, however I am cutting my time with it short as I still want there to be surprises when I play through the full game upon release! Highly reccomend!

Though it is probably best to wait to purchase til either after early access or just wait to play after because your save won't carry over.

Plays pretty close to 5th edition D&D honestly, and I DM regularly. Some bugs are present naturally but I'm sure they will be ironed out before release. Some bugs include not being able to help a downed play because they glitched through a set of stairs, just had to take a short rest and they got up though. A few minor texture things but other than that it's engaging and absolutely beautiful.
